answer: Reaching the orchard of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Each submission hangs on the pigment of a task receipt, and the hollow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
